# Scenario: stream.sni validation soft-fails and leaves prior compose/proxy alone
# (missing default; inbound.port 8443 reserved; route vs domain-name; duplicate
# server-name).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: stream sni validation baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# enabled without default
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.missing-default.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: stream.sni missing default'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'stream.sni.default is required'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# inbound.port 8443 reserved while SNI enabled
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.port-8443.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: reserved inbound 8443'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'reserved for the internal HTTPS listener'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# route server-name conflicts with proxy.inbound.domain-name
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.route-conflict.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: route conflicts with domain-name'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'conflicts with proxy.inbound.domain-name'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# duplicate stream.sni.routes server-name
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.dup-route.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: duplicate stream.sni server-name'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'duplicated'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.missing-default.yml --
version: "1.0"
stream:
  sni:
    enabled: true
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.port-8443.yml --
version: "1.0"
stream:
  sni:
    enabled: true
    default: reject
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 8443
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.route-conflict.yml --
version: "1.0"
stream:
  sni:
    enabled: true
    default: reject
    routes:
      - server-name: shop.apinfra.test
        project: e2e-broker
        service-name: broker
        port: 8883
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: shop.apinfra.test
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-broker
    enabled: true
    config: {}

-- settings.dup-route.yml --
version: "1.0"
stream:
  sni:
    enabled: true
    default: reject
    routes:
      - server-name: mqtt.e2e.apinfra.test
        project: e2e-broker
        service-name: broker
        port: 8883
      - server-name: MQTT.e2e.apinfra.test
        project: e2e-broker
        service-name: broker
        port: 8883
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-broker
    enabled: true
    config: {}

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-broker/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  broker:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do sleep 3600; done"

-- .env --
